title: RTTI-driven property streaming binds object graphs at runtime, not compile time
notes:
Forces the extraction prompt's rule #7 (RTTI usage = open question)
to fire. The C# / Java translator must choose between (a) verbose
reflection API, (b) a static-registry pattern, or (c) source-gen
— none of which are obvious from reading the Delphi. The trap is
that the property-streaming case looks like a regular setter at
first glance.
